messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG depicting a pelican riding a bicycle. Let's make a decent SVG with a bicycle (wheels, frame, handlebars, seat), and draw a pelican on top of it with its large beak and pouch. Let's compose the coordinates carefully.

Canvas: 400x300.

Bicycle: rear wheel center (110, 230), front wheel (280, 230), radius 40. Frame: bottom bracket (195, 230), seat tube goes up to (180, 165), down tube to the handlebars (260, 160), chainstay from rear wheel hub to bottom bracket, fork from handlebar area to front wheel hub, top tube from seat to handlebar stem.

Pelican sits on the saddle (about 180, 160). Body is an ellipse centered around (175, 130), neck curves up to the head around (230, 75), large beak points forward (rightward). The wing might be stretched toward the handlebars as if gripping them. Legs go down to the pedals.

Pedals: crank at bottom bracket (195, 230), crank arms to (175, 215) and (215, 245). Feet are placed there.

Add a little motion line and ground. Colors: pelican is white/gray with an orange beak.

Write clean SVG code.
answer:
Here's an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle:

```svg
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Sky background -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#bde3f0"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="50" r="25" fill="#ffd93d"/>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="270" width="400" height="30" fill="#8bc34a"/>

  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <g stroke="#7fb3c8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="20" y1="120" x2="55" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="140" x2="50" y2="140"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="160" x2="60" y2="160"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bicycle -->
  <g stroke="#37474f" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <!-- Wheels -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="230" r="40" />
    <circle cx="280" cy="230" r="40" />
    <!-- Hubs -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="230" r="5" fill="#37474f"/>
    <circle cx="280" cy="230" r="5" fill="#37474f"/>
    <!-- Spokes -->
    <g stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="110" y1="190" x2="110" y2="270"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="230" x2="150" y2="230"/>
      <line x1="82" y1="202" x2="138" y2="258"/>
      <line x1="138" y1="202" x2="82" y2="258"/>
      <line x1="280" y1="190" x2="280" y2="270"/>
      <line x1="240" y1="230" x2="320" y2="230"/>
      <line x1="252" y1="202" x2="308" y2="258"/>
      <line x1="308" y1="202" x2="252" y2="258"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Frame -->
    <line x1="110" y1="230" x2="195" y2="230"/> <!-- chainstay -->
    <line x1="110" y1="230" x2="178" y2="163"/> <!-- seat stay -->
    <line x1="195" y1="230" x2="178" y2="163"/> <!-- seat tube -->
    <line x1="178" y1="163" x2="255" y2="158"/> <!-- top tube -->
    <line x1="195" y1="230" x2="258" y2="160"/> <!-- down tube -->
    <line x1="255" y1="158" x2="280" y2="230"/> <!-- fork -->
    <!-- Handlebars -->
    <path d="M 255 158 L 258 145 Q 272 140 278 150"/>
    <!-- Seat post -->
    <line x1="178" y1="163" x2="175" y2="152"/>
    <!-- Crank -->
    <line x1="178" y1="216" x2="212" y2="244"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Saddle -->
  <path d="M 160 152 Q 175 145 190 152 Q 175 158 160 152 Z" fill="#37474f"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x="168" y="210" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#37474f"/>
  <rect x="204" y="241" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#37474f"/>

  <!-- Pelican -->
  <g>
    <!-- Tail feathers -->
    <path d="M 130 115 L 105 100 L 118 118 L 100 115 L 122 128 Z" fill="#eceff1" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="165" cy="120" rx="42" ry="30" fill="white" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="2.5"/>

    <!-- Leg to pedal -->
    <g stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path d="M 165 145 L 172 190 L 177 213"/>
      <path d="M 185 145 L 200 200 L 210 240"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Feet -->
    <path d="M 168 213 L 186 213 L 177 219 Z" fill="#f5a623"/>
    <path d="M 202 241 L 220 241 L 211 247 Z" fill="#f5a623"/>

    <!-- Wing reaching to handlebars -->
    <path d="M 185 110 Q 230 115 258 148 Q 262 156 254 156 Q 225 135 190 132 Z"
          fill="#e0e4e7" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="2.5"/>

    <!-- Neck -->
    <path d="M 195 105 Q 215 95 222 72 Q 226 55 240 52 L 250 68 Q 238 78 235 95 Q 232 112 210 118 Z"
          fill="white" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="2.5"/>

    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx="245" cy="58" r="15" fill="white" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="2.5"/>

    <!-- Beak with pouch -->
    <path d="M 255 52 L 315 58 Q 318 60 314 64 L 258 70 Z" fill="#f5a623" stroke="#d97b1f" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M 258 68 Q 285 92 312 63 Q 290 78 260 74 Z" fill="#f7c26b" stroke="#d97b1f" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx="248" cy="53" r="3.5" fill="#263238"/>
    <circle cx="249.5" cy="51.5" r="1.2" fill="white"/>

    <!-- Head tuft -->
    <path d="M 238 44 Q 240 34 248 38 Q 246 42 250 43" fill="none" stroke="#90a4ae" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

This creates a cheerful scene with:
- 🚲 **A bicycle** — spoked wheels, diamond frame, handlebars, saddle, and pedals
- 🐦 **A pelican** — signature long orange beak with a stretchy pouch, white body, wings gripping the handlebars, and webbed feet on the pedals
- ☀️ **Extras** — a sun, green ground, and motion lines to show it's cruising along!
